source_clause: ICE2.) AUTO has on/ off state. The fan speed indicator shows Auto instead of the actual fan speed and none of the Mode buttons will be shown highlighted. The main category control will display Auto with the Mode Man and Fan speed greyed out behind it. AUTO affects Fan speed, Modes, AC in order to reach desired temperature as quickly as possible. Auto is mutually exclusive with MAX A/C and MAX DEF. Pressing MAX DEF or Max A/C the system goes to that function. If Auto is turned on, these buttons are turned off. In Auto the A/C button is highlighted. Manually selecting A/C keeps the system in AUTO without compressor usage (A/C off). Manually changing airflow mode, or changing fan speeds breaks Auto. When breaking Auto the system will go to the manual mode that most closely matches the auto mode exited, unless a specific mode button is pressed, in which case the system would go to that mode. Any other climate controls do NOT break Auto. (AUTO is not shown in MTC configurations)
reasoning: 驗證目標：16.3（ICE2）以九句定出 ICS 介面之 AUTO 狀態呈現、其作用對象、互斥對象、中斷條件與 MTC 例外，九個 037 leaf 逐句對應，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：EMEA 軸取**正向值**（16.2）；第一軸 —— `107-01`～`107-08` 取 ATC 值（ICE2 末句「AUTO is not shown in MTC configurations」蘊含之），`107-09` 取 MTC 值；`107-05`／`107-06` 另補第四軸（MAX A/C，出處 16.13）與第五軸（MAX DEF，出處 3.2）；依 **R-C34** 第九軸與第十三軸暴露 → 全數補，第十二軸不補（ch16 無 tab 條文）。為什麼這樣切：`107-05`（互斥）與 `107-06`（按下即前往該功能）為同一組關係之兩個方向，可各自獨立失效。刻意略過：**鏡射表反向使用之關鍵結果 —— ICE2 與 C2 在兩處相左，本批驗 ICE2 之版本而不移植 C2**：(一) C2 之互斥對象為四氣流模式與 front defrost，ICE2 為 MAX A/C 與 MAX DEF；(二) C2 云「Auto can change the state of AC, **but do not show this change**」，ICE2 云「**In Auto the A/C button is highlighted**」—— 語意相反。批次 9 之 `003-04`／`003-05` 已因此得 `no`，此處為其另一側之實作（§8.2.1）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: ICS climate screen 之 AUTO 按鈕、風速指示、Mode 按鈕與 main category control
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section（6.3 使其移除）；**與批次 11 相反**，該批之可觀察量為 comfort popup，正是 6.3 之例外
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— ch16 十八節無 tab 條文
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（出處 2.14 C15，跨節取據 R-C29）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **不適用（反向）** —— 本節屬 ch16，取**正向**軸值 PC（出處 16.2）而非排除式；R-C36-1 於本側之對應問題為「本條於非 EMEA 車輛上有無對象」，答為無

tcs.tc_title: Fan speed indicator shows AUTO while AUTO is on
tcs.test_item: The fan speed indicator shall show Auto instead of the actual fan speed
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle has an ATC climate system, in which AUTO is shown (16.3)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn AUTO on from the climate screen
2. Read the fan speed indicator
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "AUTO" button is highlighted
2. The fan speed indicator shows Auto instead of a fan speed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: AUTO excludes MAX A/C and MAX DEF
tcs.test_item: Auto shall be mutually exclusive with MAX A/C and MAX DEF, and if Auto is turned on those buttons shall be turned off
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle has an ATC climate system, in which AUTO is shown (16.3)
3. [spec-derived] The system supports Max A/C, which is then displayed on the screen next to the A/C button (16.13)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with MAX DEF (3.2)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
6. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn "MAX A/C" on from the climate screen
2. Turn AUTO on and read the "MAX A/C" and "MAX DEF" buttons
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "MAX A/C" button is highlighted
2. Neither "MAX A/C" nor "MAX DEF" is highlighted
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.split_reason: §8.2.2 之拆分，依 75 §1 之判準（**條文列舉之項即拆分之維度**）：本節之條文逐字列舉其觸發 —— 「Pressing MAX DEF or Max A/C the system goes to that function」—— 故一觸發一條。兩個按鍵各自可失效，且其落點不同（MAX A/C 與 MAX DEF 為兩個功能）。 （**判準之反面**：條文以泛稱表述而由作者挑樣者不拆，其樣本為 interaction data，§4.5。）
